/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -C 3 'external_dependencies|Repo A|Repo B|curl|curl\\s*.*\\|' skills_manifest.json || true
index_path='<HOME>/.guyue/cache/discovery/skills-index.json'
if [ -r \""'$index_path" ]; then
  printf '"'%s\\n' \"CACHE_READABLE="'$index_path"
  stat -f '"'CACHE_MODIFIED=%Sm' -t '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z' \""'$index_path"
  rg -n -i -C 2 '"'repo a|repo b|install|curl|ecosystem|security|skill' \""'$index_path" | sed -n '"'1,220p'
else
  printf '%s\\n' \"CACHE_UNAVAILABLE="'$index_path"
fi'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1336,1425p' skills_manifest.json
index_path='<HOME>/.guyue/cache/discovery/skills-index.json'
printf '%s\\n' 'CANDIDATE_NAME_MATCHES:'
rg -n -i '\"(repo a|repo b)\"|/(repo-a|repo-b)(/|\"|"'$)'"' \""'$index_path" skills_manifest.json || true
printf '"'%s\\n' 'CACHE_POINTERS_READABLE:'
while IFS= read -r skill_path; do
  [ -r \""'$skill_path/SKILL.md" ] && printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$skill_path"
done < <(rg -o '"'\"/["'^"]+"'"' \""'$index_path" | tr -d '"'\"' | sed -n '1,20p')"
